sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Debt-to-Equity Trajectory: Leverage moved from 1.77x to 1.47x equity. Leverage is high enough to transmit an earnings shock directly into equity value.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 6.9 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +7.5% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.

Payout Ratio Sustainability: Dividends absorbed 61% of earnings against free cash flow of 23% of net profit. The payout is above what the business generates, so it depends on cash reserves or borrowing.
ROE vs. ROCE Quality: Return on capital employed of 9.0% with ROE of 15.8% is close to or below the cost of capital, so growth destroys rather than creates value.
CapEx Intensity Check: Capital expenditure averaged 21.5% of revenue. Capex intensity is unusual for the business model and needs a return check.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 2 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 5 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Interest Coverage Safety: Operating profit covers interest 3.9 times. Coverage is thin enough that a profit dip would pressure debt service.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded -0.3% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 4 hard red flags and 5 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 74/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
